title: Kombucha
tagline: We're building a systematic way for our token and others to drive new capital and trade by launching a on a vetted platform that will reach and engage with a trusted community.
description: When Kombocha gets a certain number of wallet users it will distribute new coins to the users on status that is achieved through tasks & rank. KOM is meant to be a community focused coin that will benefit all parties involved through the creation of LP (Liquidity Pools)and Farms. KOM is hoping to be the best Starter coins for new users and veterans.
